events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas, passing away six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years on, the impact of Tupac Shakur's music and powerful lyrics still resonates profoundly.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks another year since the passing of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, whose revolutionary guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That zebra crossing, those suits, that music. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album is 57 today!

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the enduring frontwoman of The Pretenders, born today in 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde, a true rock icon!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis and a formidable solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Lennon's Vision
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine' – a timeless message still resonating today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember life before? It's been 25 years since the original iPod dropped and changed the game for good.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab a martini (shaken, not stirred) – it's James Bond Day! Which 007 is your favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy and music of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the immensely talented and hilarious John Cleese!

events.title: 'The White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in the UK on this day in 1968.

angles.name: A Diverse Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of 'The White Album'! A sprawling, diverse, and utterly essential piece of The Beatles' legacy.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen, in 1991.

angles.name: Champion of Rock
angles.copy: Thirty-five years. Still unmatched. Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, a voice and showman like no other.

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Pivotal Album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, John Lennon's message of peace and love continues to inspire. Remembering a true visionary.
